results.title: An RDMA-First Object Storage System with SmartNIC Offload (ROS2)
results.summary: Presents ROS2, which offloads the DAOS object storage client (S3/POSIX-compatible) to an NVIDIA BlueField-3 SmartNIC while keeping an RDMA data plane, showing end-to-end performance comparable to the host with lower latency.

results.title: Accelerating Object Storage for AI/ML with S3 RDMA (SNIA SDC 2025)
results.summary: Conference session by Jason Goldschmidt (Dell) at SNIA Storage Developer Conference 2025 covering S3 PUT/GET data transfers over RDMA to accelerate object storage for AI/ML pipelines.

results.title: DOCA SNAP-4 Service Guide
results.summary: Official NVIDIA documentation for the DOCA SNAP-4 service on BlueField-3/4 DPUs, describing hardware-accelerated offload of NVMe and virtio-blk block storage emulation with RDMA (zero-copy) and NVMe-oF/TCP transports.

results.title: Scalio: DPU-based JBOF Key-Value Store with NVMe-oF Target Offload (OSDI '25)
results.summary: OSDI 2025 paper on scaling a DPU-based JBOF key-value store that uses NVMe-oF target offload operations, enabling one-sided RDMA reads directly from SSDs on the DPU.

results.title: Accelerate AI Inference Using DOCA for Storage (GTC 2026 Session S81773)
results.summary: NVIDIA GTC 2026 session on using DOCA for Storage to accelerate AI inference, covering BlueField DPU storage offload platforms including BlueField-4-powered context memory storage.

results.title: FlexBSO: Flexible Block Storage Offload for Datacenters
results.summary: Proposes FlexBSO, a hardware-assisted block storage offload prototype built on BlueField-2 SmartNIC with NVIDIA SNAP support, targeting reduced host CPU cost and VM EXIT overhead for datacenter IO.
